z-m-31-12.title: Ukudibanisa iitheyibhile zemindilili yeeklasi ezimbini zibe yinye
z-m-31-12.topic: Ukufumana umndilili jikelele ngemveliso yevektha yomqolo (umlinganiselo wabafundi) nematriksi yemindilili
z-m-31-12.goal: Qonda ukuba umndilili webanga awunakufunyanwa ngeetheyibhile zemindilili yeeklasi kuphela, thetha ukuba kufuneka ulwazi luni ngakumbi, uze uvakalise umndilili olinganisiweyo njengemveliso yematriksi uchaze ukuze abahlobo baqonde.

IKlasi 2: isiKorean 80, izibalo 70, isiNgesi 70. Njengematriksi, M = ( 70 80 60 ; 80 70 70 ) (umqolo ophezulu iKlasi 1, umqolo ongezantsi iKlasi 2). Kwafika isicelo sokunika imindilili yesifundo kwibanga lonke kumgca omnye. UJiwon wathi, "Dibanisa nje imindilili yeeklasi ezimbini uhlule nge-2."

z-m-31-12.s.s1.r.b: Ubukhulu abufuneki ukudibanisa imindilili. Umndilili sisixa samanqaku ahlulwe ngenani labantu.

Ukuba iiklasi ezimbini zinenani elifanayo labafundi, umndilili olula (dibanisa uhlule nge-2) ulungile.

z-m-31-04.topic: Isiphumo semathrisi yamanqaku nekholamu yobunzima (isixa esinobunzima)
z-m-31-04.goal: Kwiziphumo zokuphindaphinda imathrisi yamanqaku nekholamu yobunzima, bonisa ngobunzima obuzenzela ukuba ucwangciso lunokutshintsha ngokuxhomekeke ebunzimeni, uze uxele ulwazi olufunekayo kwisaziso esifanelekileyo.
z-m-31-04.material: Uhlolo lokusebenza lunamacandelo amathathu, umsebenzi, intetho, nesivivinyo, nganye ngamanqaku ali-100. Amanqaku abafundi aba-2 abonakaliswa yimathrisi yamanqaku S = ( 90 60 70 ; 70 85 75 ) (umqolo ongaphezulu 가, umqolo osezantsi 나). Ukuba ubunzima bubekwa njengekholamu yematrix w = ( w₁ ; w₂ ; w₃ ) (umsebenzi, intetho, isivivinyo), inqaku eliphelele yi-S·w. Ubunzima bonke kufuneka bube ngu-0.1 okanye ngaphezulu kwaye budibane bube ngu-1. Ubunzima abukagqitywa. z-m-31-01.s.s2.r.a: Ibala kuphela iindlela ezineenyawo ezi-2 kanye, ngoko iphosisa iikspresi. I-1→2 kulo msebenzi yimeko enjalo kanye.

z-m-31-01.s.s2.r.c: Ibala kuphela iindlela ezineenyawo ezi-3 kanye, ngoko ayihambelani nalo mbuzo.

z-m-31-02.title: Ukufumana umgca owaphambukayo kwisisombululo se-equation yematriksi
z-m-31-02.topic: I-equation yematriksi AX=B nolandelelwano lokuphindaphinda i-inverse
z-m-31-02.goal: Kwisisombululo se-equation yematriksi, fumana uze ulungise imigca apho ukurhoxiswa kungenasizathu, uze uchaze ngeemeko ukuba kwenzeka ntoni kwizisombululo ze-equation xa imatriksi yekoyifishenti ingenayo i-inverse.
z-m-31-02.material: U-Haram ufuna ukufumana imatriksi X ye-2×2 kwi-equation yematriksi AX = B. A = ( 2 1 ; 1 1 ), B = ( 4 1 ; 3 2 ) (phambi kwekhoma yenxalenye ngumqolo ongaphezulu kwaye emva kwayo ngumqolo ongezantsi). A⁻¹ ifundwa 'i-inverse ye-A.' Isisombululo sika-Haram singezantsi.
z-m-31-02.thinking.0: Ukuhlola umgca ngamnye wesisombululo ukufumana impazamo yokuqala
z-m-31-02.thinking.2: Ukugweba isigqibo semeko engenayo i-inverse ngokwahlula ngokweB
z-m-31-02.prereq.0: I-H3 yalo msebenzi yinqanaba lobunzima kuphela kunye nenqanaba lenkxaso yalo cwangciso lwemveliso, kwaye ayithethi ukuba ikharityhulam inikela oku kwelo banga. Sicinga ukuba ukuphindaphinda imatriksi ye-2×2, ii-determinant, nee-inverse matrices (ezikhoyo xa ad−bc≠0) kwenziwe.
z-m-31-02.prereq.1: Uyayazi ukuba imveliso yeematriksi inokutshintsha xa ulandelelwano lutshintshiwe.
z-m-31-02.s.s1.prompt: Khetha umgca kwisisombululo sika-Haram apho into engachanekanga ivela kuqala khona. Bala amanani emigca ukususela kwi-1.
z-m-31-02.s.s1.hint.0: Bhala kumgca ngamnye ngowuphi umthetho (ukuphindaphinda macala omabini, AA⁻¹ = E, njalo njalo) olandela kumgca wangaphambili, uze uhlole ukuba iimeko zokusebenzisa lo mthetho zazihlangenwe na.
z-m-31-02.s.s1.hint.1: Faka isiphumo X somgca 5 kwi-AX = B, uphindaphinde ngqo, uze uhlole ukuba silingana no-B na.
z-m-31-02.s.s1.line.0: I-determinant ye-A yi-2·1 − 1·1 = 1, ngoko i-A ine-inverse.
z-m-31-02.s.s1.line.2: Ukuphindaphinda i-A⁻¹ ngasekunene kwamacala omabini e-AX = B kunika i-AXA⁻¹ = BA⁻¹.
z-m-31-02.s.s1.line.3: AA⁻¹ = E, ngoko kwi-AXA⁻¹ i-A ne-A⁻¹ ziyanyamalala kwaye X = BA⁻¹.
z-m-31-02.s.s1.explain: I-equation yomgca 3 ibambile kuba imatriksi efanayo iphindaphindwa kwicala elifanayo lamacala omabini. Kodwa umgca 4 awuchanekanga. Kwi-AXA⁻¹, i-X ihleli phakathi kwe-A ne-A⁻¹, ngoko iimatriksi ezimbini azisecaleni komnye. Ukuphindaphinda imatriksi akunakulungelelaniswa kwakhona, ngoko awukwazi ukusebenzisa i-AA⁻¹ = E. Ukubala ngokwako kwimigca 1 ukuya kwi-3 nomgca 5 kuchanekile, kodwa i-X = ( 3 −2 ; 1 1 ) efunyenwe ngenxa yomgca 4 ayanelisi i-AX = B (AX = ( 7 −3 ; 4 −1 )). Ukuba utshintsha icala oliphindaphinda kulo, ufumana X = ( 1 −1 ; 2 3 ) kwaye AX = B iyasebenza.
z-m-31-02.s.s2.prompt: Ukuba A yi-( 1 2 ; 2 4 ), i-determinant yi-1·4 − 2·2 = 0, ngoko ayinayo i-inverse. Kule meko, khetha zonke ii-B apho imatriksi X ye-2×2 eyanelisa i-AX = B ikhona.
z-m-31-02.s.s2.hint.0: Phindaphinda i-AX ngqo uze ubhale umqolo ongaphezulu nomqolo ongezantsi ngamangeniso e-X (x₁ x₂ ; x₃ x₄).
z-m-31-02.s.s2.hint.1: Fumana ukuba ngubudlelwane obuthini obuhlala bukho phakathi komqolo ongaphezulu nomqolo ongezantsi, uze uvavanye obo budlelwane kwi-B nganye.
z-m-31-02.s.s2.r.a: Ukuba AX = E, X kuya kufuneka ibe yi-inverse ye-A, kodwa i-A ayinayo i-inverse. Uphosise ukuba le B iyafana nengxaki ye-inverse ye-A.
z-m-31-02.s.s2.r.b: Le yi-B apho umqolo ongezantsi ngamaxesha ama-2 omqolo ongaphezulu. Umqolo ongezantsi we-AX uhlala ungamaxesha ama-2 omqolo ongaphezulu, ngoko kukho isisombululo.
z-m-31-02.s.s2.r.c: Uyazi ukuba zikho ii-B ezinesisombululo nokuba azinayo i-inverse, kodwa ukhethe ungahlolanga ubudlelwane phakathi kwemiqolo emibini ye-B. Umqolo ongezantsi (3 4) awungamaxesha ama-2 omqolo ongaphezulu (1 2).
z-m-31-02.s.s2.r.d: Ukuba uthatha ne-X njengematriksi yezero, i-AX = B iyasebenza. Ukungabi nayo i-inverse akuthethi 'akukho sisombululo.'
z-m-31-02.s.s2.r.e: Umqolo ongezantsi ngamaxesha ama-2 omqolo ongaphezulu, ngoko kukho isisombululo. Ngokomzekelo, X = ( 2 2 ; 0 0 ).
z-m-31-02.s.s2.explain: Kwi-A = ( 1 2 ; 2 4 ), umqolo ongaphezulu we-AX 'ngumqolo ongaphezulu we-X kunye namaxesha ama-2 omqolo ongezantsi we-X' kwaye umqolo ongezantsi ngamaxesha ama-2 oko. Ngoko kukho isisombululo kuphela xa umqolo ongezantsi we-B ungamaxesha ama-2 omqolo ongaphezulu. Inyaniso yokuba akukho i-inverse ayithethi 'akukho sisombululo kuyo yonke i-B' kodwa 'ngokuxhomekeke kwi-B, kusenokuba nesisombululo okanye ungabi naso.'
z-m-31-02.s.s3.prompt: Umhlobo uthi, "Ukuba i-A ayinayo i-inverse, i-AX = B ayinakusonjululwa." Phendula ukuba kwimeko enjani esi sitatimenti singachanekanga, ubandakanya umzekelo omnye.
z-m-31-02.s.s3.hint.0: Nge-A engenayo i-inverse, khetha i-B elula kakhulu (umzekelo, enamangeniso onke angu-0) uze uhlole ukuba ikho i-X eyanelisa i-AX = B.
z-m-31-02.s.s3.hint.1: Kumzekelo owufumeneyo, cacisa ngokubhala ukuba ukuphindaphinda i-AX ngqo kunika i-B na.
z-m-31-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ingaba inkcazo yam ihlula 'ayinakusonjululwa' kwi-'zikho iimeko apho inokusonjululwa'?
z-m-31-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ingaba ndihlolile ngokuphindaphinda ngqo ukuba umzekelo endiwunikileyo wanelisa nyani i-AX = B?
z-m-31-02.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ingaba ndixele uphawu lwe-B enesisombululo (ubudlelwane phakathi kwemigca emibini)?
z-m-31-02.s.s3.model.0: Hayi. Nokuba akukho nto iguqulayo, kunokubakho isisombululo ngokuxhomekeke ku-B. Umzekelo, ukuba B yi-matrix engu-zero, ukuthatha u-X njenge-matrix engu-zero kwenza AX = B.
z-m-31-02.s.s3.model.1: Zikho iimeko ezinesisombululo nazo. Ukuba B yi-( 3 5 ; 6 10 ), apho umqolo osezantsi unamaxesha ama-2 omqolo ongaphezulu, isonjululwa ngu-X = ( 3 5 ; 0 0 ). Ngoko akunyanga ukuba ayinakusonjululwa ngokungabikho kokuguqula kuphela.

z-m-31-03.title: Ukufumana umthetho womatshini kwiirekhodi zeengeniso neziphumo
z-m-31-03.topic: Ukufumana iingeniso zematrix ye-2×2 ehambisa amanqaku (ukwanela kolwazi)
z-m-31-03.goal: Njengoko iirekhodi zengeniso-isiphumo zikhula umgca o-1 ngexesha, gweba ukuba ziingeniso zingaphi zematrix ye-2×2 ezimiselweyo, uze ufumane wena umqathango weengeniso eziluncedo ekufumaneni ngokupheleleyo imatrix.
z-m-31-03.material: Kukho umatshini othatha inqaku (x, y) njenge-column matrix uze uliphindaphinde nge-matrix ye-2×2 M = ( a b ; c d ) enezigaba ezingatshintshiyo ukulihambisela kwinqaku elitsha ( ax+by , cx+dy ). Phambi kwe-semicolon ngumqolo ongaphezulu yaye emva kwayo ngumqolo osezantsi. Asiwazi amaxabiso ka-a, b, c, d, kodwa ukuba sifaka inqaku, sinokufumana isiphumo esichanekileyo. Masibone esinokukufunda ngo-M njengoko songeza iirekhodi umgca o-1 ngexesha.

Sicinga ukuba uziqhelanisile nokuphindaphinda imatrix ye-2×2 ngecolumn matrix ye-2×1 nokuhambisa inqaku (x, y) usebenzisa imatrix (isiphumo = ( ax+by , cx+dy )).
z-m-31-03.prereq.1: Ngamava oqhagamshelwano, uyazi ngokuqikelela ukuba zingaphi izilinganiso ezifunekayo ukufumana ezingaziwayo ezi-4.

z-m-31-03.s.s1.hint.0: Faka amanani amabini engeniso ngqo kwi-ax+by ne-cx+dy, uze ubhale ukuba ngoonobumba abaphi abashiyekileyo kwamabinzana.
z-m-31-03.s.s1.hint.1: Thelekisa amabinzana erekhodi entsha namaxabiso sele efunyenwe ngaphambili, uze uphawule ukuba ngaba kukho unobumba osandula ukumiselwa.
z-m-31-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Ukuba ufaka (1, 0), isiphumo yi-( a·1+b·0 , c·1+d·0 ) = ( a , c ). Unokuthi ikholamu yokuqala yi-(2, 3), kodwa b no-d azikavelli kulingano.

z-m-31-11.title: Ingaba inkcazelo enye ye-equation iqinisekisa ukubakho kwematriksi ephikisileyo?
z-m-31-11.topic: Ukugweba ukubakho kwematriksi ephikisileyo ngobudlelwane malunga nematriksi
z-m-31-11.goal: Ukusuka kubudlelwane u-A abwanelisayo, hlela iimeko apho ungaqiniseka khona ukuba A inomatriksi ophikisileyo neemeko apho ungenakuqiniseka, uze ufumane umgca ophosakeleyo kwingxoxo eqala kwingcinga uyilungise ngomzekelo ochasayo.
z-m-31-11.material: A yimatriksi ye-2×2, E yimatriksi yesazisi, kwaye O yimatriksi ye-zero. Masijonge ubudlelwane obune obulandelayo: (가) A² − 3A + 2E = O, (나) A² − 3A = O, (다) A² + E = O, (라) A² = O. Sifuna ukufumanisa ukuba singathi u-A onelisa ngamnye 'ngokuyimfuneko unomatriksi ophikisileyo'.
z-m-31-11.thinking.1: Ukubonisa ukubakho ngokwakha umatriksi ophikisileyo ngokuthe ngqo
z-m-31-11.thinking.2: Ukufumana umgca engxoxweni obuyisela isigqibo kwingcinga
z-m-31-11.prereq.0: I-H3 yalo msebenzi yinqanaba lobunzima nenkxaso yesicwangciso sale mveliso kuphela, kwaye ayithethi ukuba ikharityhulam isabela esi siqulatho kuloo banga. Sicinga ukuba uyazi iimveliso zeematriksi ezizikwere ze-2×2, imatriksi yesazisi E nematriksi ye-zero O, nenkcazelo yematriksi ephikisileyo (B enoku-AB = BA = E).
z-m-31-11.prereq.1: Uyazi ukuba umthetho wokwabela nomthetho wokudibanisa ubamba kwiimveliso zeematriksi.
z-m-31-11.s.s1.prompt: Khetha onke ubudlelwane apho ungathi bonke u-A abunelisayo ngokuyimfuneko banomatriksi ophikisileyo.
z-m-31-11.s.s1.hint.0: Zama ukubona ukuba ubudlelwane ngabunye bunokuguqulwa bube yifom 'ukuphindaphinda u-A ngematriksi ethile kunika u-E.'
z-m-31-11.s.s1.hint.1: Kubudlelwane apho kunzima ukuvakalisa ukuba umatriksi ophikisileyo ukhona, fumana u-A omnye othe ngqo onelisa ubudlelwane uhlole.
z-m-31-11.s.s1.r.a: A = O unelisa obu budlelwane, kodwa imatriksi ye-zero ayinawo umatriksi ophikisileyo. Asikwazi ukuthi ngokuyimfuneko inawo.
z-m-31-11.s.s1.r.c: Ukuba A² yimatriksi ye-zero kwaye A inomatriksi ophikisileyo, ukuphindaphinda amacala omabini ngo-A⁻¹ kunika A = O, ukuphikisana nokuba nomatriksi ophikisileyo. A onelisa obu budlelwane akanakuba nomatriksi ophikisileyo.
z-m-31-11.s.s1.explain: (가) yi-A(A − 3E) = −2E, ngoko A·(−½(A − 3E)) = E, oko kuthetha ukuba kukho umatriksi ophikisileyo −½(A − 3E). (다) yi-A·(−A) = E, ngoko kukho umatriksi ophikisileyo −A. (나) inemizekelo echasayo njengo-A = O, kwaye (라) ngokuchaseneyo yimeko engenakuba nomatriksi ophikisileyo.
z-m-31-11.s.s2.prompt: Umfundi wabhala ingxoxo ezama ukubonisa ukuba A onelisa (나) A² − 3A = O ngokuyimfuneko unomatriksi ophikisileyo. Khetha umgca wokuqala ophosakeleyo.

z-m-31-11.s.s2.hint.1: Thelekisa ukuba uluhlu oluthethwa ngumgca 4 ('onke') luyafana noluhlu olubonisiweyo ngumgca 2 no-3.

Awunakuchaza zonke iimeko ngesiphumo esifunyenwe kwingcinga. Enyanisweni A = O unelisa inkcazelo, kodwa asiyo-3E kwaye akanawo umatriksi ophikisileyo.

z-m-31-13.title: Yeyiphi imithetho emibini yee-determinant ekufuneka siyithembe?
z-m-31-13.topic: Iingcinga nokuhlolwa kwe-determinant yemveliso det(AB) neyesixa det(A+B)
z-m-31-13.goal: Ulwazi lokuba umzekelo omnye okanye emibini wenza kube nzima ukwahlula imithetho, gweba uluhlu apho umthetho usebenza khona ngemizekelo echasayo nokwandiswa konobumba, uze wakhe iimeko ezibambe ngethuba wena.
z-m-31-13.material: Kwiimatriksi ze-2×2 A no-B, kukho imithetho emibini ekhetheka. (R1) det(AB) = det(A)·det(B), (R2) det(A+B) = det(A) + det(B). Apha det yi-determinant. Sifuna ukufumanisa ukuba loluphi umthetho olusoloko lusebenza.
z-m-31-13.prereq.0: I-H3 yalo msebenzi yinqanaba lobunzima kuphela kunye nenqanaba lenkxaso yalo cwangciso lwemveliso, kwaye ayithethi ukuba ikharityhulam inikela oku kwelo banga. Sicinga ukuba uyayazi imveliso nesixa seematriksi ze-2×2 kunye ne-determinant ad−bc.
z-m-31-13.s.s1.prompt: Idatha ivezwa inxalenye enye ngexesha. Ixesha ngalinye, khetha isigwebo sakho ngo-R1 no-R2.
z-m-31-13.s.s1.hint.0: Kumthetho ngamnye kwezi mbini, hlela kwitheyibhile ukuba zingaphi imizekelo ebambe ukuza kuthi ga ngoku nezingaphi eziphumelele.

z-m-31-13.s.s1.st.0.info: Kwi-A = ( 1 0 ; 0 1 ) kunye ne-B = ( 1 2 ; 3 −1 ), det(AB) = −7 = 1·(−7) kunye ne-det(A+B) = −6 = 1 + (−7). Imithetho yomibini yabamba kulo mzekelo.
z-m-31-13.s.s1.st.0.ask: Uya kugweba njani u-R1 no-R2 kule bini enye?
z-m-31-13.s.s1.st.0.after: Ngenxa yeemeko ezizodwa zokuba A yimatriksi yobunjalo kunye nokuba i-trace ye-B ngu-0, imithetho yomibini yabamba ngethuba. Lo mzekelo awunakwahlula le mithetho mibini.
z-m-31-13.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Imithetho yomibini isebenza kuzo zonke iibini zeematriksi
z-m-31-13.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Umzekelo omnye ukuchaneka akwenzi zonke iimeko zichaneke. Zimbini imithetho enika isiphumo esifanayo, ngoko ayinakwahlulwa.

z-m-31-13.s.s1.st.1.after: U-R2 wenqatshwa ngebini enye yomzekelo ochasayo. U-R1 wayechanekile kwiibini ezimbini, ngoko ukholo luyakhula, kodwa asizizo zonke iibini ezihloliweyo okwangoku.
z-m-31-13.s.s1.st.1.o.a: U-R2 unika umzekelo ochasayo, ngoko mmale. U-R1 uyathandeka ngakumbi ngoku, kodwa akaqinisekiswa okwangoku

z-m-31-13.s.s1.st.2.info: Vumela A = ( a b ; c d ) kunye no-B = ( e f ; g h ) uze wandise, kwaye det(AB) = (ae+bg)(cf+dh) − (af+bh)(ce+dg) iba lula ibe yi-(ad−bc)(eh−fg) (ukwandiswa kuqinisekisiwe). Kwanjalo det(A+B) − det A − det B = ah + de − bg − cf.
z-m-31-13.s.s1.st.2.after: Ukwandiswa konobumba kuqinisekisa ukuba u-R1 usebenza kuzo zonke iibini ze-2×2. Kodwa oku kuqinisekiswa kulinganiselwe kwi-2×2, kwaye i-3×3 okanye ngaphezulu kufuneka ijongwe ngokwahlukeneyo. U-R2 usebenza kuphela xa ah + de − bg − cf = 0.
z-m-31-13.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Kuqinisekiswe ngokwandisa ngonobumba, hayi ngemizekelo embalwa, ukuba usebenza kuzo zonke iibini zeematriksi ze-2×2, ngoko sinokuthi usoloko usebenza kwiimatriksi ze-2×2

z-m-31-13.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ukwandisa ngonobumba kusingatha zonke iimeko zamanani ngexesha elinye. Akukho mfuneko yokuvavanya omnye ngomnye.

z-m-31-13.s.s1.st.2.o.d: U-R2 naye usoloko esebenza ukuba wandiswa ngonobumba

z-m-31-13.s.s2.prompt: Xa A yimatriksi yobunjalo E, yenza ii-B ezintathu ezahlukeneyo = ( e f ; g h ) apho u-R2 (det(E+B) = det E + det B) ubamba ngethuba (ngaphandle kwematriksi yezero).

z-m-31-13.s.s2.explain: det(E+B) = (1+e)(1+h) − fg = 1 + e + h + eh − fg, kwaye 1 + det B = 1 + eh − fg, ngoko ukuze amaxabiso amabini alingane, e + h = 0. Oko kukuthi, u-R2 usebenza kuphela xa i-trace ye-B ingu-0.
z-m-31-13.s.s2.because.prompt: Bhala oko ii-B ozifumeneyo zinako ngokufanayo (ubudlelwane phakathi kwamangeniso), uze wongeze isivakalisi esinye ngokuba kwenzeka ntoni kuR2 kwi-B engagcini obo budlelwane.
z-m-31-13.s.s2.because.hint.0: Bhala macala ngamacala u-e no-h wee-B ozifumeneyo uze ufumane isixa samanani amabini.
z-m-31-13.s.s2.because.hint.1: Nge-B enye apho e + h ingengo-0, bala amaxabiso amabini ngqo uze uwathelekise.
z-m-31-13.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ingaba ubudlelwane obufanayo bubamba kuzo zonke ii-B endizifumeneyo?
z-m-31-13.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ingaba ndikhethe i-B enye apho ubudlelwane buphukayo ndahlola ukuba amaxabiso amabini ahluke ngenene?
z-m-31-13.s.s2.because.model.0: Zonke ii-B endizifumeneyo zine-e + h = 0 (isixa sengeniso ephezulu ekhohlo neyezantsi ekunene singu-0). Ngaphandle kwalobu budlelwane, umzekelo nge-( 1 2 ; 3 1 ), det(E+B) = −2 kodwa 1 + det B = −4, ngoko u-R2 akasebenzi.
z-m-31-13.s.s2.because.model.1: Kuzo zonke ii-B ezintathu, amangeniso e-diagonal (ephezulu ekhohlo, engezantsi ekunene) adibana angu-0. Xa ndaphula leyo meko, u-R2 akasebenzanga.
